title: The treatment credit-result operation is not in the TSD S2 endpoint inventory
source: TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 T-A.1; legacy RWB-E2-006 section 12; Microservice Ownership Map v1
description: TSD S2 T-A.1 carries four operations (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004) and none of them records a credit result, while the legacy contract defines POST /treatments/{treatmentId}/credit-result and the Ownership Map keeps that path on the integration base. The treatment owner's write operation, its suffix, its request entity name and its response are not stated.
evidence: TSD S2 v3 T-A.1 rows API-S2-001 to API-S2-004; legacy section 12 table of the two endpoints
proposed: Publish POST /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}/credit-result with the legacy CreditResult body on the treatment base, and have the integration-base operation of the same suffix call it

title: The treatment state values of a credit result are not in a list of values
source: TSD S2 v3 T3.0 and T3.2; legacy RWB-E2-006 section 9
description: Legacy section 9 moves the treatment state from SUBMITTED to APPROVED or REFUSED, but TSD S2 T3.2 gives no list for the record state: T3.0 carries only state varchar(40) as the record lifecycle state, and LOV-TRT-OUTCOME holds KEPT, BROKEN, COMPLETED, CANCELED and DECLINED, which are outcomes and not these values.
evidence: TSD S2 v3 T3.0 standard columns; T3.2 lists of values; legacy section 9 paragraph
proposed: Accept SUBMITTED, APPROVED and REFUSED as record lifecycle values of treatment.state and add them to the service list when the data model is next issued

title: Paths and answer shapes of the two consumed contracts are not published
source: TSD S2 v3 T6.2 and T5.2; RWB-P3-E1043-CON
description: TSD S2 T6.2 requires the authorise contract of rwb-access and DP-07 requires the reference-data contract of rwb-case, but neither document states the path, the query parameters, the answer shape or the text of the error messages MSG-P4-001, MSG-P4-003 and MSG-GEN-006 that this story maps.
evidence: TSD S2 v3 T6.2 paragraph; T5.2.2 table; legacy section 14 carries no text for the three messages
proposed: Read both answers through the published contracts of rwb-case and rwb-access and take the concrete paths from API Specification v5 when the files are issued; the message texts stay as recorded in section 14 of the story

title: The nullability and the refusal check of the four credit columns are not specified
source: TSD S2 v3 T3.1; legacy RWB-E2-006 section 13
description: TSD S2 T3.1 lists DF-TRT-023 to DF-TRT-026 with their types and marks each one not required, and states no rule between credit_result and credit_result_reason. The rule that a refusal carries a reason appears only in the legacy solution plan, not in the data model.
evidence: TSD S2 v3 T3.1 rows DF-TRT-023 to DF-TRT-026; legacy section 13 database paragraph
proposed: Add the check credit_result_reason is not null when credit_result = 'REFUSED' in the migration of this story, in rwb_treatment

title: The format of the NLEADS reference is assumed and not confirmed
source: Legacy RWB-E2-006 section 12; DL12; TSD S2 v3 T3.1
description: The legacy contract states 1 to 30 letters, digits and dashes for nleads_ref and records the format as assumed until SCB IT confirms it under DL12. TSD S2 gives only the physical type varchar(30) and no pattern.
evidence: Legacy section 12 POST row; TSD S2 v3 T3.1 DF-TRT-023
proposed: Validate 1 to 30 characters of letters, digits and dashes and keep the rule as a reference row so a confirmed format is a configuration change

title: The approval-level comparison sits on one endpoint in the legacy story and on another service in the target
source: Legacy RWB-E2-006 AC7 and BR5; TSD S2 v3 T4; RWB-P7-E2006-APP
description: The legacy story refuses a result whose NLEADS approval level is below the level the plan needs on the same endpoint that records the result. In the target the level the delegation of authority requires and the comparison belong to the rwb-decision slice, and this service only stores the level as recorded, so the refusal happens before this operation is called.
evidence: Legacy section 5 X5 and section 7 AC7; TSD S2 v3 T4 rule table has no level rule; RWB-P7-E2006-APP section 7 AC6
proposed: Keep the comparison with the rwb-decision slice and the caller slice; the treatment validates list membership only, and the legacy AC7 is proved in RWB-P7-E2006-APP

title: The build dependency row is empty while the decoupling table adds four platform contracts
source: Work package B2-S2-015 story line; Template and Rules R5.5
description: The work package fixes Depends on (build), Contract dependencies, Integration dependencies and External dependencies as empty, while the DP table adds H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, H RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, H RWB-PLT-E1044-CON and H RWB-PLT-N001-CON for DP-03, DP-07, DP-15 and DP-19.
evidence: Work package story line dependencies; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-03, DP-07, DP-15, DP-19 rows
proposed: Keep the metadata row as the work package fixes it, list the four platform contracts in the pattern table, and let the assembler reconcile the lane when the platform CON stories are numbered

title: The treatment record screen presentation of the credit result is not specified
source: Legacy RWB-E2-006 section 15; Screen inventory and navigation v2
description: Legacy section 15 names SCR-14 and the two states of the panel, and the screen inventory gives no field list, layout or masking rule for the NLEADS reference, the result, the level, the result date and the reason.
evidence: Legacy section 15 paragraph; screen inventory carries SCR-14 only as a record screen
proposed: Show the five values read only on the treatment panel; the final layout and masking follow the design work and change no contract

title: The service context pack and the S2 extracts named by the work package are not present
source: Work package B2-S2-015 read-only list; run workspace _work/msr
description: The work package lists _work/msr/context/S2.md and the S2 extract files of the FSD and TSD folders as read-only inputs, and neither the context folder nor the extract folder exists in this workspace. Service facts were therefore taken from the service note of FSD S2 v4 and the T0 sections of TSD S2 v3.
evidence: The folder _work/msr holds only assumptions and smoke at the time of the run; the FSD S2 v4 and TSD S2 v3 document control sections carry the same service row
proposed: Use the FSD S2 v4 and TSD S2 v3 service rows as the authority for this story and reconcile the context pack when it is issued; no value in the story changes if the pack agrees
